meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构优化机会,生成可视化报告并深入剖析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护日渐庞杂的代码库,想找到架构改进的发力点
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase for architecture improvements, then dive into each one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically uncover architecture improvement areas in your codebase

howto.what: 它会扫描你的代码库，找出把「浅模块」改深的重构机会，生成一份带前后对比图的 HTML 报告，存到系统临时目录并自动打开。你挑中一个后，它再陪你逐步推敲方案。
howto.when: 当你显式调用它时触发，它不会自动接管；你可以先点名某个模块、子系统或痛点作为方向，不点名时它会从 git 提交历史里找改动热点入手。

say.note: 生成 HTML 报告并打开

say.note: 以该模块作为扫描方向

howto.what_en: It scans your codebase for chances to turn shallow modules into deep ones, writes a self-contained HTML report with before/after diagrams to the OS temp dir, opens it, then grills through whichever candidate you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you invoke it explicitly; it won't take over on its own. You can name a module, subsystem, or pain point, or it picks recent commit hot spots itself.

say_en.text: Scan this codebase for architecture problems
say_en.note: Writes an HTML report and opens it

say_en.text: Focus on refactoring chances in the orders module
say_en.note: Uses that module as the scan scope
